title: Floor Raiser or Ceiling Limiter? Differential Storytelling Outcomes with a Child-Centric GenAI System Across Individual Differences
reasoning: The paper focuses on the educational outcomes of a GenAI system for children's storytelling. It contains a section on 'Ethical Considerations' which addresses procedural research ethics (IRB approval, informed consent, data privacy), but it does not study or evaluate religious, moral, or ethical reasoning within the AI models themselves.
